description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Samurai], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Azure Oblivion Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Samurai
description.text: Samurai abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Azure Oblivion Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Azure Oblivion 1/2 after using three Ice abilities if user hasn't/has Retaliate or High Retaliate

description.name: Azure Oblivion 1
description.text: One single attack (5.20) capped at 99999, causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [High Retaliate] to the user

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: High Retaliate
description.text: Evades PHY attacks, counters PHY attacks with an ability (PHY: single, 1.20 physical)

description.name: Azure Oblivion 2
description.text: One single attack (5.20) capped at 99999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] and [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] to the user
